name: Verifiable Execution Layer for Supply Chain and Global Trade

mentions.name: Verifiable Execution Layer for Supply Chain and Global Trade
mentions.description: A verifiable execution layer for supply chain and global trade that serves as a coordination layer for the physical economy. It integrates with existing enterprise systems through a simple API without requiring changes to those systems, supporting coordination across cross-border trade, manufacturing, and banking.
mentions.problem: Coordinating supply chain, cross-border trade, manufacturing, and banking is difficult without disrupting existing enterprise systems.
mentions.audience: Enterprises involved in supply chain, global trade, manufacturing, and banking
mentions.source_excerpt:
We are working on verifiable execution layer for supply chain and global trade without changing the enterprise systems. A coordination layer for executing physical economy.

We integrate to the existing systems with an simple API.
